jobs.title: Visual Merchandising Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

- The Visual Merchandising Manager is responsible for defining, implementing and continuously elevating the visual merchandising standards across all onboard retail environments of MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- The role ensures that every boutique delivers a premium and consistent guest experience while respecting the identity of each cruise brand and the visual standards of the world's leading luxury and premium brands.

- With a particular focus on Fashion & Accessories, the role also coordinates the visual execution of Watches & Jewelry and Beauty & Duty Free boutiques in close collaboration with brand partners and Category teams.

- Working across HQ functions, onboard retail teams, architects, designers and luxury maisons, the Visual Merchandising Manager transforms commercial strategies into inspiring retail environments that maximize customer engagement and commercial performance.

Your Impact

Global Visual Merchandising Strategy

- Develop and continuously evolve the global visual merchandising strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Establish visual standards that reflect the positioning of each cruise brand while maintaining commercial effectiveness.

- Ensure consistency of visual execution across the global fleet.

- Develop seasonal visual merchandising calendars supporting commercial initiatives and product launches.

- Create scalable visual standards adaptable to different ship classes and boutique formats.

Fashion & Accessories Visual Leadership

- Lead all visual merchandising activities for Fashion & Accessories boutiques.

- Develop display concepts that enhance product storytelling and elevate the guest shopping experience.

- Optimize product presentation to improve visibility, conversion and average transaction value.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury retail best practices while adapting to operational realities onboard.

Watches, Jewelry & Beauty Coordination

- Coordinate with luxury watch, jewelry and beauty brands to ensure visual execution complies with brand guidelines.

- Manage the implementation of brand display furniture, point-of-sale materials, animations and seasonal campaigns.

- Coordinate installation of showcases, displays and branded environments during new openings and refurbishments.

- Act as the primary visual merchandising contact for supplier visual teams.

Retail Experience & Guest Journey

- Develop immersive retail experiences that encourage product discovery and storytelling.

- Ensure visual merchandising supports the overall guest journey across all retail spaces.

- Collaborate with Marketing to translate campaigns into engaging in-store experiences.

- Promote experiential retail through animations, pop-ups, product launches and seasonal activations.

Newbuilds & Boutique Development

- Support retail design for new ships, refurbishments and dry docks.

- Collaborate with architects, designers and Category teams to optimize store layouts and product presentation.

- Recommend fixtures, furniture, lighting, materials and display solutions aligned with luxury retail standards.

- Participate in boutique commissioning and opening preparations.

Brand Standards & Governance

- Develop and maintain the Global Visual Merchandising Guidelines.

- Conduct regular fleet audits to ensure compliance with visual standards.

- Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through performance analysis and guest feedback.

- Maintain strong relationships with visual merchandising teams from luxury brand partners.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal VM material delivery.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Visual Merchandising function across the organization.

- Inspire a culture of creativity, attention to detail and luxury excellence.

- Coach onboard visual champions and retail teams on visual merchandising best practices.

- Promote innovation while ensuring operational simplicity and executional consistency.

Your Journey so far

- 8+ years of experience in Visual Merchandising within luxury fashion, premium retail or travel retail.

- Strong experience working with internationally recognized luxury and premium brands.

- Experience developing visual merchandising standards across multiple stores or international markets.

- Experience supporting new store openings and retail concept development.

- Experience in luxury department stores, fashion retail or travel retail is highly desirable.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury visual merchandising principles and premium customer experience.

- Strong aesthetic sensitivity combined with commercial awareness.

- Excellent knowledge of fashion presentation, styling and luxury retail codes.

- Experience collaborating with luxury brands and managing brand visual guidelines.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Creative mindset supported by strong execution capabilities.

- Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels regularly.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Il meglio delle vostre avventure è quello che dovete ancora navigare!

Il tuo scopo

- Il Visual Merchandising Manager è responsabile per la definizione, l'implementazione e l'elevazione continua degli standard di merchandising visivo in tutti gli ambienti di vendita onboard di MSC Cruises e Explora Journeys.

- Il ruolo assicura che ogni boutique offre un'esperienza guest premium e coerente nel rispetto dell'identità di ogni marchio di crociera e degli standard visivi dei marchi leader mondiali di lusso e premium.

- Con un particolare focus su Fashion & Accessories, il ruolo coordina anche l'esecuzione visiva delle boutique Orologi & Gioielli e Beauty & Duty Free in stretta collaborazione con partner di marca e team di categoria.

- Lavorando attraverso le funzioni HQ, i team di vendita a bordo, gli architetti, i designer e le maison di lusso, Visual Merchandising Manager trasforma le strategie commerciali in ambienti di vendita al dettaglio che massimizzano l'impegno del cliente e le prestazioni commerciali.

Il tuo impatto

Strategia globale di Visual Merchandising

- Sviluppare e evolvere continuamente la strategia globale di merchandising visivo attraverso MSC Crociere e viaggi Explora.

- Stabilire standard visivi che riflettono il posizionamento di ogni marchio di crociera pur mantenendo l'efficacia commerciale.

- Assicurare la coerenza dell'esecuzione visiva in tutta la flotta globale.

- Sviluppa calendari di merchandising visivo stagionali che supportano iniziative commerciali e lanci di prodotti.

- Creare standard visivi scalabili adattabili a diverse classi di nave e formati boutique.

Moda & Accessori Leadership visiva

- Guida tutte le attività di merchandising visivo per le boutique Fashion & Accessories.

- Sviluppa concetti di visualizzazione che migliorano la narrazione del prodotto e elevano l'esperienza di shopping degli ospiti.

- Ottimizzare la presentazione del prodotto per migliorare la visibilità, la conversione e il valore medio delle transazioni.

- Assicurare che le collezioni siano presentate secondo le migliori pratiche di vendita al dettaglio di lusso mentre si adattano alle realtà operative a bordo.

Orologi, Gioielli e Bellezza Coordinamento

- Coordinate con orologi di lusso, gioielli e marchi di bellezza per garantire l'esecuzione visiva conforme alle linee guida del marchio.

- Gestire l'implementazione di mobili display di marca, materiali di punta di vendita, animazioni e campagne stagionali.

- Coordinate l'installazione di vetrine, display e ambienti di marca durante nuove aperture e ristrutturazioni.

- Agire come il contatto visivo primario merchandising per i team visivi del fornitore.

Esperienza di vendita al dettaglio e viaggio degli ospiti

- Sviluppa esperienze di vendita al dettaglio immersive che incoraggiano la scoperta dei prodotti e la narrazione.

- Assicurarsi che la merchandising visiva supporti il viaggio ospiti complessivo in tutti gli spazi di vendita al dettaglio.

- Collabora con Marketing per tradurre campagne in coinvolgendo esperienze in-store.

- Promuovere la vendita al dettaglio esperienziale attraverso animazioni, pop-up, lanci di prodotti e attivazioni stagionali.

Newbuilds & Boutique Development

- Supporto design al dettaglio per nuove navi, ristrutturazioni e banchine a secco.

- Collabora con architetti, designer e team di Categoria per ottimizzare i layout dei negozi e la presentazione dei prodotti.

- Raccomandare apparecchi, mobili, illuminazione, materiali e soluzioni di visualizzazione allineate agli standard di lusso di vendita al dettaglio.

- Partecipare alla messa in servizio e all'apertura della boutique.

Standard di marca & Governance

- Sviluppare e mantenere le Linee Guida Globale di Merchandising.

- Condurre controlli regolari della flotta per garantire il rispetto degli standard visivi.

- Identificare opportunità di miglioramento continuo attraverso analisi delle prestazioni e feedback degli ospiti.

- Mantenere forti relazioni con team di merchandising visivo di partner di lusso del marchio.

Collaborazione funzionale trasversale

- Collabora a stretto contatto con le operazioni di vendita al dettaglio per massimizzare l'esecuzione commerciale a bordo.

- Lavorare con Gestione Pianificazione e Ordine per garantire la consegna ottimale del materiale VM.

- Partner con Performance per monitorare la redditività della categoria e le prestazioni di investimento.

- Interfaccia con dipartimenti e stakeholder interfunzionali per garantire un coordinamento ottimale, comunicazione, allineamento ed esecuzione in tutta l'organizzazione.

Leadership

- Guidare e sviluppare la funzione Visual Merchandising in tutta l'organizzazione.

- Ispira una cultura della creatività, l'attenzione al dettaglio e l'eccellenza del lusso.

- Coach onboard campioni visivi e team di vendita al dettaglio su visual merchandising best practice.

- Promuovere l'innovazione garantendo al tempo stesso semplicità operativa e coerenza esecutiva.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 8+ anni di esperienza in Visual Merchandising all'interno di moda di lusso, vendita al dettaglio premium o vendita al dettaglio di viaggio.

- Forte esperienza di lavoro con marchi di lusso e premium riconosciuti a livello internazionale.

- Sperimenta lo sviluppo di standard di merchandising visivo in più negozi o mercati internazionali.

- Esperienza che supporta nuove aperture di negozio e sviluppo di concept retail.

- L'esperienza nei grandi magazzini di lusso, la vendita al dettaglio di moda o la vendita al dettaglio di viaggio è altamente desiderabile.

I tuoi essenziali

- Profonda comprensione dei principi di merchandising visivo di lusso e dell'esperienza di cliente premium.

- Forte sensibilità estetica unita alla consapevolezza commerciale.

- Ottima conoscenza della presentazione della moda, dello stile e dei codici di vendita al dettaglio di lusso.

- Esperienza di collaborazione con marchi di lusso e gestione delle linee guida visive del marchio.

- Forte gestione del progetto e competenze organizzative.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.

- Capacità di lavorare in ambienti multiculturali e internazionali.

- Mindset creativo supportato da forti capacità di esecuzione.

- Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale e navi a bordo regolarmente.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Wo Leidenschaft auf Chance trifft

Das Beste deiner Abenteuer ist das, das du noch nicht gesegelt hast!

Dein Zweck

- Der Visual Merchandising Manager ist für die Definition, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Standards für visuelles Merchandising in allen Einzelhandelsumgebungen von MSC Cruises und Explora Journeys verantwortlich.

- Die Rolle stellt sicher, dass jede Boutique ein erstklassiges und konsistentes Gästeerlebnis bietet und gleichzeitig die Identität jeder Kreuzfahrtmarke und die visuellen Standards der weltweit führenden Luxus- und Premiummarken respektiert.

- Mit einem besonderen Fokus auf Fashion & Accessories koordiniert die Rolle auch die visuelle Ausführung von Uhren & Schmuck und Beauty & Duty Free Boutiquen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Markenpartnern und Category-Teams.

- Arbeiten über HQ-Funktionen, Onboard-Einzelhandelsteams, Architekten, Designer und Luxusmaisons, verwandelt der Visual Merchandising Manager kommerzielle Strategien in inspirierende Einzelhandelsumgebungen, die Kundenbindung und kommerzielle Leistung maximieren.

Ihre Wirkung

Globale Visual Merchandising Strategie

- Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der globalen Visual Merchandising-Strategie für MSC Cruises und Explora Journeys.

- Legen Sie visuelle Standards fest, die die Positionierung jeder Kreuzfahrtmarke widerspiegeln und gleichzeitig die kommerzielle Wirksamkeit wahren.

- Gewährleistung der Konsistenz der visuellen Ausführung in der globalen Flotte.

- Entwicklung von saisonalen Visual Merchandising-Kalendern, die kommerzielle Initiativen und Produkteinführungen unterstützen.

- Erstellen Sie skalierbare visuelle Standards, die an verschiedene Schiffsklassen und Boutique-Formate angepasst werden können.

Mode & Zubehör Visuelle Führung

- Führen Sie alle visuellen Merchandising-Aktivitäten für Fashion & Accessories Boutiquen.

- Entwickeln Sie Display-Konzepte, die das Produkt-Storytelling verbessern und das Einkaufserlebnis der Gäste verbessern.

- Optimieren Sie die Produktpräsentation, um Sichtbarkeit, Conversion und den durchschnittlichen Transaktionswert zu verbessern.

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Kollektionen nach den Best Practices des Luxuseinzelhandels präsentiert werden, während Sie sich an die operativen Gegebenheiten an Bord anpassen.

Uhren, Schmuck & Beauty Koordination

- Koordinieren Sie sich mit Luxusuhren, Schmuck und Schönheitsmarken, um sicherzustellen, dass die visuelle Ausführung den Markenrichtlinien entspricht.

- Verwalten Sie die Implementierung von Markenmöbeln, Point-of-Sale-Materialien, Animationen und saisonalen Kampagnen.

- Koordinieren Sie die Installation von Vitrinen, Displays und Markenumgebungen während neuer Eröffnungen und Renovierungen.

- Handeln Sie als primärer Visual Merchandising-Kontakt für visuelle Lieferantenteams.

Retail Experience und Guest Journey

- Entwickeln Sie immersive Einzelhandelserlebnisse, die Produktentdeckung und Storytelling fördern.

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass Visual Merchandising die gesamte Gästereise in allen Einzelhandelsbereichen unterstützt.

- Arbeiten Sie mit dem Marketing zusammen, um Kampagnen in ansprechende In-Store-Erlebnisse zu übersetzen.

- Förderung des experimentellen Einzelhandels durch Animationen, Pop-ups, Produkteinführungen und saisonale Aktivierungen.

Neubauten & Boutiquenentwicklung

- Unterstützen Sie das Einzelhandelsdesign für neue Schiffe, Renovierungen und Trockendocks.

- Arbeiten Sie mit Architekten, Designern und Category-Teams zusammen, um die Layouts und die Produktpräsentation zu optimieren.

- Empfehlen Sie Leuchten, Möbel, Beleuchtung, Materialien und Display-Lösungen, die auf Luxus-Einzelhandelsstandards ausgerichtet sind.

- Nehmen Sie an der Boutique-Beauftragung und Eröffnungsvorbereitungen teil.

Brand Standards & Governance

- Entwicklung und Pflege der Global Visual Merchandising Guidelines.

- Führen Sie regelmäßige Flottenaudits durch, um die Einhaltung der visuellen Standards sicherzustellen.

- Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung durch Leistungsanalyse und Gästefeedback.

- Pflegen Sie starke Beziehungen zu visuellen Merchandising-Teams von Luxusmarkenpartnern.

Funktionale Cross Collaboration

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Retail Operations, um die kommerzielle Ausführung an Bord zu maximieren.

- Arbeiten Sie mit dem Planungs- und Auftragsmanagement zusammen, um eine optimale Lieferung von VM-Material sicherzustellen.

- Partnerschaft mit Performance zur Überwachung der Kategorie Rentabilität und Investitionsperformance.

- Schnittstelle mit funktionsübergreifenden Abteilungen und Stakeholdern, um eine optimale Koordination, Kommunikation, Ausrichtung und Ausführung im gesamten Unternehmen zu gewährleisten.

Führung

- Führen und entwickeln Sie die Visual Merchandising-Funktion im gesamten Unternehmen.

- Inspirieren Sie eine Kultur der Kreativität, der Liebe zum Detail und der Luxusexzellenz.

- Coaching von visuellen Champions und Einzelhandelsteams zu Best Practices im Bereich Visual Merchandising.

- Förderung von Innovationen bei gleichzeitiger Gewährleistung der betrieblichen Einfachheit und der Konsistenz der Ausführung.

Deine Reise bisher

- 8+ Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Visual Merchandising im Bereich Luxusmode, Premium-Einzelhandel oder Reiseeinzelhandel.

- Starke Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit international anerkannten Luxus- und Premiummarken.

- Erleben Sie die Entwicklung von visuellen Merchandising-Standards in mehreren Geschäften oder internationalen Märkten.

- Erfahrung in der Unterstützung neuer Ladeneröffnungen und der Entwicklung von Einzelhandelskonzepten.

- Erfahrung in Luxus-Kaufhäusern, Mode-Einzelhandel oder Reiseeinzelhandel ist sehr wünschenswert.

Ihre Essentials

- Tiefes Verständnis der Prinzipien des visuellen Merchandising und der Premium-Kundenerfahrung.

- Starke ästhetische Sensibilität kombiniert mit kommerziellem Bewusstsein.

- Ausgezeichnetes Wissen über Modepräsentation, Styling und Luxus-Einzelhandelscodes.

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Luxusmarken und der Verwaltung von visuellen Markenrichtlinien.

- Starkes Projektmanagement und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.

- Hervorragende Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten.

- Fähigkeit, in multikulturellen und internationalen Umgebungen zu arbeiten.

- Kreative Denkweise, unterstützt durch starke Ausführungsfähigkeiten.

- Bereitschaft, international und regelmäßig an Bord von Schiffen zu reisen.

Unser Engagement

Wir setzen uns für eine Zukunft ein, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertschätzt, die Welt über Grenzen hinaus umfasst und ein integratives Umfeld fördert, in dem sich jeder Mensch geschätzt, respektiert und ermächtigt fühlt, sein authentisches Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute, um Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen überschreitet und etwas Bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Le meilleur de vos aventures est celui que vous n'avez pas encore navigué !

Votre but

- Le responsable de la marchandisation visuelle est chargé de définir, de mettre en œuvre et d'élever en permanence les normes de marchandisation visuelle dans tous les environnements de détail embarqués de MSC Cruises et Explora Journeys.

- Le rôle de chaque boutique garantit une expérience haut de gamme et cohérente tout en respectant l'identité de chaque marque de croisière et les normes visuelles des grandes marques de luxe et de luxe au monde.

- Avec un accent particulier sur la mode & Accessoires, le rôle coordonne également l'exécution visuelle des boutiques Montres & Joaillerie et Beauté & Duty Free en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires de marque et les équipes de catégorie.

- Travaillant à travers les fonctions de l'AC, les équipes de vente au détail embarquées, les architectes, les concepteurs et les maisons de luxe, le Visual Merchandising Manager transforme les stratégies commerciales en environnements de vente au détail inspirants qui maximisent l'engagement client et la performance commerciale.

Votre impact

Stratégie mondiale de marchandisation visuelle

- Développer et évoluer en permanence la stratégie globale de merchandising visuel à travers MSC Cruises et Explora Journeys.

- Établir des normes visuelles qui reflètent le positionnement de chaque marque de croisière tout en maintenant l'efficacité commerciale.

- Assurer la cohérence de l'exécution visuelle dans la flotte mondiale.

- Élaborer des calendriers de merchandising visuel saisonniers à l'appui des initiatives commerciales et des lancements de produits.

- Créez des normes visuelles évolutives adaptables à différentes classes de navires et formats boutique.

Mode & Accessoires Leadership visuel

- Dirigez toutes les activités de merchandising visuel pour les boutiques Fashion & Accessories.

- Élaborer des concepts d'affichage qui améliorent le récit des produits et augmentent l'expérience d'achat des clients.

- Optimiser la présentation des produits pour améliorer la visibilité, la conversion et la valeur transactionnelle moyenne.

- S'assurer que les collections sont présentées selon les meilleures pratiques de vente au détail de luxe tout en s'adaptant aux réalités opérationnelles à bord.

Montres, Bijoux & Coordination Beauté

- Coordonner avec les marques de montres de luxe, de bijoux et de beauté pour s'assurer que l'exécution visuelle est conforme aux directives de la marque.

- Gérer la mise en œuvre de meubles d'affichage de marque, matériaux de point de vente, animations et campagnes saisonnières.

- Coordonner l'installation des vitrines, des présentoirs et des environnements de marque lors des nouvelles ouvertures et rénovations.

- Agir comme premier contact de marchandisation visuelle pour les équipes visuelles du fournisseur.

Expérience de vente au détail & Voyage invité

- Développer des expériences immersive de vente au détail qui encouragent la découverte de produits et la narration.

- Veiller à ce que le merchandising visuel supporte le voyage des clients dans tous les espaces de vente au détail.

- Collaborer avec Marketing pour traduire les campagnes en des expériences en magasin.

- Promouvoir la vente expérientielle par des animations, des pop-ups, des lancements de produits et des activations saisonnières.

Développement de nouvelles constructions et boutiques

- Soutenir la conception de détail pour les nouveaux navires, rénovations et quais secs.

- Collaborez avec les architectes, les designers et les équipes de catégorie pour optimiser la présentation des magasins et des produits.

- Recommander des installations, des meubles, de l'éclairage, des matériaux et des solutions d'affichage conformes aux normes de détail de luxe.

- Participer aux préparatifs de mise en service et d'ouverture de boutique.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Head of Watches & Jewelry Product Category is the global business owner for the Watches & Jewelry category across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role is responsible for defining and executing the global category strategy, driving commercial performance, developing a world-class assortment, and building long-term partnerships with leading watch and jewelry maisons.

Working closely with Retail Operations, Planning & Budget, and Supply Chain, this role ensures the category delivers exceptional guest experiences while maximizing sales, profitability and brand equity across all ships.

The position combines strategic category management with strong commercial leadership to continuously elevate the onboard retail offering across both contemporary and luxury environments.

Your Impact

Category Strategy & Business Ownership

- Own the global Watches & Jewelry category strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Define the long-term category vision aligned with the commercial objectives and positioning of each cruise brand.

- Identify emerging trends, market opportunities and guest expectations to continuously evolve the category.

- Build a balanced portfolio across fine jewelry, fashion jewelry, luxury watches, contemporary watches and exclusive collections.

- Develop category roadmaps supporting future fleet expansion, new concepts and new brand introductions.

Commercial Performance

- Deliver category sales, gross margin and profitability targets.

- Monitor category performance through KPI analysis, identifying opportunities and corrective actions.

- Optimize product mix, pricing architecture, promotional activities and inventory productivity.

- Lead forecasting and assortment planning in collaboration with Demand Planning and Order Management teams.

- Drive continuous improvement of productivity per SKU, per brand, per boutique and per vessel.

Product Development & Assortment Management

- Curate compelling assortments adapted to guest demographics, regions, itineraries and ship profiles.

- Develop exclusive products, capsule collections and cruise-only editions with strategic partners.

- Manage the full product lifecycle from selection and onboarding to phase-out.

- Ensure assortment reflects market trends while preserving a coherent brand architecture.

- Balance innovation with proven commercial performers.

Brand Partnerships

- Develop and manage relationships with global watch and jewelry brands.

- Lead commercial negotiations including trading terms, exclusivities, product launches and joint business plans.

- Identify and onboard new brands aligned with the Group retail strategy.

- Coordinate supplier performance reviews and continuous business development initiatives.

- Represent MSC Group during industry events, trade fairs and partner meetings.

Merchandising & Retail Excellence

- Define merchandising guidelines specific to the Watches & Jewelry category.

- Collaborate with Visual Merchandising to create premium boutique experiences that enhance conversion and storytelling.

- Support newbuilds, refurbishments and boutique redesigns from a category perspective.

- Ensure collections are presented according to luxury brand standards and visual excellence.

- Partner with onboard teams to continuously improve category execution.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Retail Operations to maximize onboard commercial execution.

- Work with Planning and Order Management to ensure optimal inventory availability while minimizing excess stock.

- Partner with Performance to monitor category profitability and investment performance.

- Interface with cross-functional departments and stakeholders to ensure optimal coordination, communication, alignment and execution across the organization.

Leadership

- Lead and develop the Watches & Jewelry merchandising team.

- Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration and commercial excellence.

- Coach team members and support succession planning.

- Encourage data-driven decision making while maintaining strong customer and brand focus.

Your Journey so far

- 10+ years of experience in luxury watches and/or jewelry merchandising.

- Proven success managing international product categories within luxury retail, travel retail or omnichannel environments.

- Strong experience in assortment planning, buying, supplier negotiations and category management.

- Experience working with internationally recognized watch and jewelry brands.

- Experience in luxury retail or travel retail environments is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of luxury watches and jewelry markets, trends and consumer behavior.

- Strong commercial and financial acumen with excellent analytical skills.

- Proven ability to negotiate and build long-term strategic supplier partnerships.

- Excellent understanding of merchandising principles, assortment architecture and inventory optimization.

- Strong project management and organizational skills.

- Ability to work across multicultural and international environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Passion for luxury retail and delivering exceptional guest experiences.

- Willingness to travel internationally.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Your Purpose

The Jewelry Product Development Senior Manager is responsible for transforming creative concepts into commercially successful jewelry collections across MSC Cruises. Working closely with the in-house Jewelry Designer, the Head of Watches & Jewelry, industrial partners and suppliers, the role leads the end-to-end product development process from concept validation through industrialization and market launch while ensuring each collection is commercially balanced, technically feasible, financially viable and aligned with the positioning of each cruise brand. The role combines creativity, product expertise and industrial know-how to build distinctive jewelry collections that strengthen the Group's exclusive retail offering.

Your Impact

Collection Development

- Lead the end to end development of exclusive jewelry collections from concept to launch.

- Translate creative vision into commercially successful products while preserving design integrity.

- Build structured collections with balanced product architecture, pricing, materials, and customer segments.

- Identify portfolio gaps and propose new product opportunities.

- Maintain collection freshness through seasonal updates, new launches, and limited editions.

Supplier & Industrial Partner Management

- Find suppliers and manage relationships with jewelry manufacturers and production partners.

- Identify and onboard new suppliers to support growth and innovation.

- Evaluate suppliers based on quality, craftsmanship, innovation, capacity, ethical sourcing, and competitiveness.

- Facilitate technical collaboration between designers and manufacturers.

- Support supplier negotiations with Procurement.

Collection Architecture & Portfolio Management

- Analyze sales and customer insights to identify assortment opportunities.

- Recommend portfolio rationalization to improve productivity.

- Develop long term collection roadmaps aligned with brand strategy.

Product Development

- Coordinate prototypes, technical drawings, sampling, approvals, and production readiness.

- Ensure products meet quality, cost, timing, and commercial targets.

- Monitor product performance throughout its lifecycle and drive improvements.

- Support collection launches across the network.

Quality & Product Excellence

Lavorando a stretto contatto con l'in-house Jewelry Designer, il Head of Watches & Jewelry, partner industriali e fornitori, il ruolo guida il processo di sviluppo del prodotto end-to-end dalla convalida del concetto attraverso l'industrializzazione e il lancio del mercato, assicurando che ogni collezione sia commercialmente bilanciata, tecnicamente fattibile, finanziariamente fattibile e allineata con il posizionamento di ogni marchio di crociera. Il ruolo coniuga creatività, competenza del prodotto e know-how industriale per costruire collezioni di gioielli distintive che rafforzano l'esclusiva offerta di vendita al dettaglio del Gruppo.

Il tuo impatto

Sviluppo della raccolta

- Condurre lo sviluppo finale di esclusive collezioni di gioielli dal concept al lancio.

- Traduci la visione creativa in prodotti di successo commerciale, preservando l'integrità del design.

- Costruisci collezioni strutturate con equilibrate architetture dei prodotti, prezzi, materiali e segmenti dei clienti.

- Identificare le lacune del portafoglio e proporre nuove opportunità di prodotto.

- Mantenere la freschezza della collezione attraverso aggiornamenti stagionali, nuovi lanci e edizioni limitate.

Gestione dei partner industriali

- Trova fornitori e gestisci relazioni con produttori di gioielli e partner di produzione.

- Identificare e a bordo nuovi fornitori per sostenere la crescita e l'innovazione.

- Valutare i fornitori basati sulla qualità, l'artigianato, l'innovazione, la capacità, l'etica sourcing e la competitività.

- Facilita la collaborazione tecnica tra designer e produttori.

- I negoziati dei fornitori di supporto con Procurement.

Collezione Architettura e Gestione Portfolio

- Valuta costantemente la forza e la completezza del portafoglio di gioielli moda.

- Mantenere una rappresentazione equilibrata tra categorie, materiali, pietre preziose, finiture e punti di prezzo.

- Analizzare le vendite e le informazioni dei clienti per identificare le opportunità di assortimento.

- Razionalizzazione del portafoglio per migliorare la produttività.

- Sviluppare roadmap di raccolta a lungo termine allineati con la strategia di marca.

Sviluppo del prodotto

- Gestisci il calendario di sviluppo del prodotto e il percorso critico.

- Coordinate prototipi, disegni tecnici, campionamento, approvazioni e prontezza di produzione.

- Assicurare che i prodotti soddisfino obiettivi di qualità, costi, tempi e commerciali.

- Monitorare le prestazioni del prodotto durante il suo ciclo di vita e migliorare l'unità.

- La raccolta di supporto lancia in tutta la rete.

Qualità e eccellenza del prodotto

- Assicurarsi che tutti i prodotti soddisfino standard qualitativi, normativi e di marca.

- Coordinate le approvazioni di test, convalida e produzione.

- Partner con i team di qualità per risolvere i problemi e migliorare le prestazioni dei prodotti.

- Mantenere un'artigianato eccezionale in tutte le collezioni.

Collaborazione funzionale trasversale

- Partner con il Jewelry Designer in tutto il processo creativo.

- Allineare lo sviluppo del prodotto con la strategia di categoria accanto al Capo Orologi & Gioielli.

- Collabora con Retail Operations per massimizzare l'esecuzione commerciale.

- Lavorare con la pianificazione e la gestione degli ordini per ottimizzare i livelli di inventario.

- Partner con i team Performance per monitorare la redditività e i rendimenti di investimento.

- Coordinare efficacemente con gli stakeholder funzionali incrociati per garantire l'allineamento e l'esecuzione.

Innovazione

- Monitora le tendenze dei gioielli, i materiali, le tecniche di produzione e le preferenze dei consumatori.

- Esplora nuovi materiali, pietre preziose, finiture e tecnologie di produzione.

- Benchmark concorrenti e identificare opportunità di differenziazione.

- Guidare l'innovazione mantenendo la fattibilità commerciale e operativa.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 8+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del prodotto di gioielli, nella gestione della collezione o nella gestione del prodotto, idealmente nello spazio della Gioielleria Contemporanea

- Esperienza di lavoro con produttori di gioielli e partner di produzione.

- Forte comprensione dei processi di produzione di gioielli, dei materiali e dell'artigianato.

- Esperienza di gestione dei calendari di sviluppo del prodotto e coordinamento dei fornitori.

- L'esperienza all'interno di gioielli di lusso è altamente desiderabile.

I tuoi essenziali

- Profonda comprensione dello sviluppo del prodotto di gioielli dal concetto alla produzione.

- Forte conoscenza delle tecniche di produzione, dei materiali e degli standard di qualità.

- Ottima gestione del progetto e competenze organizzative.

- Sensibilizzazione commerciale con la capacità di bilanciare la creatività e la redditività.

- Forte capacità analitiche e comprensione dell'architettura di raccolta.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e gestione delle relazioni.

- Capacità di coordinare più stakeholder attraverso funzioni creative, tecniche e commerciali.

- Passione per gioielli di lusso e innovazione di prodotto.

- Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale a fornitori e partner di produzione.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Bring the MSC Cruises experience to life across our global social channels.

As a freelance Social Media Specialist, you will support our Global Social Media team in developing relevant content, managing editorial calendars and building meaningful interactions with our audiences. Combining creative judgement with performance insights, you will turn brand priorities and emerging trends into content that connects with audiences across platforms and markets.

You will collaborate closely with our social media team, content creators and editor, taking ownership of agreed deliverables from initial idea through publication and performance review.

This is an external freelance opportunity under a services agreement. You must have a registered business.

Your Impact

Content and editorial planning

- Develop and manage editorial calendars across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Broadcast Channels, Threads and Pinterest.

- Schedule and publish approximately 20 posts per primary channel per month, coordinating always-on content, campaigns, press releases and toolkits.

- Write engaging, platform-specific captions and apply SEO and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) principles to improve content discoverability.

- Contribute fresh concepts to every editorial plan and support creator briefs for key brand moments, including new ship launches and onboard shoots.

- Coordinate with MSC content creators and the editor to prepare content for publication.

- Manage market folders in Meta Business Suite, enabling local teams to access and publish global content.

Reactive content and innovation

- Identify content opportunities through audience behaviour, content gap analysis, search insights and historical performance.

- Monitor trending formats, sounds and cultural moments, translating relevant opportunities into timely, brand-appropriate proposals.

- Coordinate reactive content using existing brand assets and stock material, and support the finalisation of creator-produced content.

- Test new formats and creative approaches, define hypotheses and assess results.

- Monitor platform developments and recommend relevant features and content experiments.

Performance and reporting

- Analyse performance weekly across all active platforms, including search queries and engagement patterns, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

- Deliver ad hoc analysis on specific content initiatives, including CGI, AI-generated content and partnership campaigns.

- Prepare quarterly reporting covering competitor benchmarking and labelling compliance.

Community and engagement

- Manage community interactions across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and YouTube Shorts.

- Moderate comments within 30 minutes of publication for active posts, within agreed coverage arrangements.

- Identify and engage in relevant conversations on third-party channels daily, and prepare a monthly recap of standout interactions.

- Review the CreatorIQ inbox to identify influencer mentions and select user-generated content, supporting up to 150 UGC assets per year.

- Support crisis monitoring by tracking emerging topics, recurring themes and audience reactions, escalating issues to the appropriate team.

Additional content support

- Support branding initiatives, competition asset coordination and Instagram content localisation for markets.

- Maintain and organise YouTube playlists.

- Produce blog content supporting the Pinterest SEO strategy.

Your Journey so far

- Proven experience in social media management, editorial planning and community engagement for a brand or agency.

- Strong English copywriting skills and the ability to adapt content to different platforms, audiences and brand priorities.

- A critical eye for social content, with a clear understanding of what makes an idea relevant and effective for a brand.

- Confidence interpreting performance data and using insights to improve content, engagement and discoverability.

- Hands-on familiarity with Creator Studio, Emplifi and YouTube Studio, alongside Meta Business Suite.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (three currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for an accomplished editorial and marketing leader to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

We are seeking a highly skilled and Gen-AI savvy Consumer Communications Director to shape how our brand is experienced through language. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for delivering a distinctive, consistent, and elevated brand voice across all content, overseeing copy development with final editorial responsibility, and driving impactful onboard marketing that elevates the guest experience and drives commercial performance.

Your Impact

- Editorial leadership & tone of voice: Establish and own the brand editorial standard. Translate complex hospitality offerings into clear, emotionally engaging messaging that elevates perceived value. Bring a talent for making the long or unclear short, simple and impactful, ensuring every word reflects the elegance, warmth and exclusivity of a luxury hospitality brand with a consistent tone of voice. Maintain copy frameworks, messaging guidelines, and tone-of-voice documentation.

- Creative writing and storytelling at scale: Lead the development of clear, compelling and brand-aligned copy across all channels and touchpoints. Oversee and write high-quality content including brand stories, destination narratives and hospitality experiences, subsequently scaling this across channels and audiences, meeting the specific requirements of each touchpoint.

- Editorial responsibility and proofreading: Establish rigorous quality standards and processes and personally sign off every single piece of consumer-facing copy to meet the brand’s editorial standards, ensuring clarity, grammatical accuracy and stylistic consistency, adjusted for differentiated channels, audiences and situations.

- Onboard marketing: Lead the onboard marketing team, owning content and copy strategy, ensuring all communication enhances the guest experience and supports the delivery of onboard revenue targets. Develop clear and compelling messaging across onboard channels including e.g. printed in-suite materials, digital screens, App content and in-suite TV content.

- Copywriter network management: oversee and continuously optimise the external copywriter network, ensuring consistent quality, speed, cost efficiency and flexible capacity to meet business needs. Brief and guide copywriters to deliver consistent messaging and tone of voice, with content tailored to each channel and audience. Proactively manage the resource and supplier mix, bringing in new talent and capabilities where required and transitioning out suppliers that no longer meet business needs. Maintain a scalable network that can adapt to changing priorities and accommodate significant, periodic increases in volume without compromising quality or timely delivery.

- AI amplification to deliver scale and speed: use and champion the responsible use of Gen-AI and emerging tools to increase creative scale, speed and efficiency across the copy lifecycle—from ideation and drafting to editing, adaptation and optimisation. Combine technology with impeccable human taste, editorial judgment and brand stewardship to ensure AI-enabled content consistently meets brand standards.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in journalism, communications, English, media or a related field

- 10+ years of editorial, copywriting, journalism, communications or brand storytelling experience, with substantial exposure to travel, cruise, luxury or destination content

- Native English speaker a non-negotiable must, native British English speaker strongly preferred

Your Essentials

- Exceptional command of English writing, editing, and proofreading.

- Outstanding leadership, coaching and people development skills. Excellent collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to navigate a matrix organisation. Structured, well organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects, thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment. Proven ability to roll-up your sleeves and execute with excellence.

- Excellent storytelling skills, with a refined aesthetic sensibility and understanding of luxury brand positioning. A strong portfolio demonstrating sophisticated, persuasive, and brand-sensitive copy.

- Demonstrated flexibility to adapt content for different audiences (e.g. B2B vs B2C) and different channels (e.g. Press releases, speeches, Customer Service FAQs, In-suite letters, with proven experience writing for digital platforms) while maintaining brand integrity.

- Proven experience prompting AI tools and creating AI agents for ideation, content creation, and editing to augment capacity and increase output, while keeping strong editorial judgment over final copy

- Familiarity with GEO & SEO copywriting principles

- Deep appreciation for luxury hospitality, travel experiences, and high-end service culture. Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever evolving and luxury travel industry.

- Self-learner, continuously testing and learning with creative technologies and AI-assisted workflows.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

The position acts as a strategic business partner, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across all retail categories

Your Impact

Business Performance Analytics

- Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.

- Provide regular performance analysis by:

- Ship

- Boutique

- Category

- Brand

- SK

- Itinerary

- Guest segment

- Identify commercial opportunities and performance gaps.

- Translate data into clear recommendations and action plans for Retail Leadership and Category teams.

KPI Framework & Reporting

- Define and improve the global retail KPI framework, including:

- Sales performance

- Conversion rate

- Average Transaction Value (ATV)

- Units Per Transaction (UPT)

- Sales per square meter / selling space

- Sell-through

- Gross margin

- Inventory productivity

- Stock turn

- Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.

- Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.

Demand & Inventory Analytics

- Support demand forecasting by SKU, ship, boutique and geographic area.

- Analyze sales trends, seasonality, itinerary impact and guest behavior to improve forecasts.

- Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.

- Provide recommendations for:

- Allocation

- Replenishment

- Stock balancing

- Inventory optimization

- Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.

Commercial Control & Profitability

- Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.

- Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.

- Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.

- Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.

- Evaluate profitability by:

- Product

Assortment & Category Insights

- Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.

- Analyze:

- Product productivity

- SKU contribution

- Collection performance

- Brand performance

- Price architecture

- Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.

- Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.

- Monitor inventory health across the fleet.

- Identify:

- Overstock situations

- Stock shortages

- Obsolete inventory

- Low productivity products

- Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.

- Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.

Data Management & Tools

- Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.

- Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.

- Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with:

- Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics

- Category Managers

- Retail Operations

- Merchandise Planning

- Finance

- Supply Chain

- IT / Digital teams

- Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions

Your Journey so far

- 5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.

- Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.

- Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.

- Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.

- Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.

Your Essentials

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills.

- Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.

- Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

- Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.

- Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).

- Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.

- Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.

- Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.

- Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Marketing & Client Engagement Manager is responsible for developing and executing the retail activation strategy across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys, with the objective of increasing guest engagement, driving boutique traffic and supporting commercial performance.

The role creates and manages the onboard retail activation calendar, including events, micro-events, brand animations, VIP experiences and local initiatives designed to enhance the guest journey and maximize retail opportunities.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, onboard teams, CRM, Marketing and luxury brand partners, the role transforms retail strategies into memorable experiences that generate customer engagement, conversion and loyalty.

Your Impact

Retail Activation Strategy

- Define and manage the global retail activation framework across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

- Develop an annual activation calendar aligned with commercial priorities, seasonality, itineraries, and guest profiles.

- Create initiatives that drive boutique traffic, customer engagement, and sales performance.

- Balance major events with agile onboard activations.

- Ensure all activations reflect the positioning of each brand.

Event & Experience Management

- Develop and execute onboard retail events, including product launches, brand showcases, VIP experiences, collection previews, and seasonal activations.

- Manage event concepts, timelines, logistics, and execution.

- Partner with luxury brands to leverage expertise, ambassadors, and activation resources.

- Measure event performance and implement improvements.

Traffic Generation & Commercial Activation

- Develop initiatives that increase boutique visitation and customer engagement.

- Create activation plans around new products, hero items, seasonal moments, itineraries, guest segments, and special occasions.

- Partner with Retail Operations to convert activations into commercial results.

- Introduce innovative approaches to attract diverse guest profiles.

VIP & Client Engagement

- Develop VIP engagement strategies with CRM and onboard teams.

- Create personalized retail experiences for high value guests.

- Support clienteling initiatives, including private appointments, exclusive previews, tailored product recommendations, and luxury brand experiences.

- Strengthen guest loyalty and encourage repeat purchases.

Local & Destination Based Activations

- Develop activations tailored to destinations, itineraries, and guest profiles.

- Build partnerships with relevant local stakeholders where appropriate.

- Adapt activation strategies to regional opportunities.

- Integrate destination storytelling into retail experiences.

Brand Partner Collaboration

- Partner with luxury and premium brands to deliver joint activations and events.

- Manage brand participation and execution standards onboard.

- Ensure alignment between brand objectives and MSC / Explora commercial priorities.

- Coordinate all required brand assets and activation requirements.

Content & Communication Coordination

- Collaborate with Marketing, CRM, and onboard teams to maximize activation visibility.

- Support the development of invitations, digital communications, onboard announcements, guest messaging, and promotional materials.

- Ensure consistent storytelling across all guest touchpoints.

Performance Measurement

- Define and track KPIs including attendance, traffic, sales uplift, conversion, engagement, and VIP participation.

- Analyze results and continuously optimize activation strategies.

- Share best practices and successful initiatives across the fleet.

Cross Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with the VP Global Retail & Luxury, Retail Operations, Category Management, Visual Merchandising, Training, and onboard leadership teams.

- Ensure retail activations support broader commercial and guest experience objectives.

Your Journey so far

- 7+ years of experience in retail marketing, luxury events, client engagement or experiential marketing.

- Experience within luxury retail, travel retail, hospitality or premium brands.

- Proven experience creating and executing customer engagement initiatives.

- Strong experience managing events, partnerships and commercial activations.

- Experience working with luxury brands and VIP clientele is highly desirable

Your Essentials

- Strong understanding of luxury customer experience and experiential retail.

- Excellent project management and event execution skills.

- Strong commercial mindset with ability to link activation to business results.

- Creative thinker with ability to develop engaging concepts.

- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple projects in an international environment.

- Strong understanding of CRM, clienteling and customer engagement principles.

- Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally and onboard vessels.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business performance and delivering integrated, objective, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

As a key member of the Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics team, he/she will have the opportunity to work with large-scale datasets and advanced technologies, developing deep expertise in the core business. To succeed in this role, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst must have a strong passion for data analysis, reporting, and uncovering meaningful insights. The role requires the ability to interpret complex information, assess business implications, and provide impactful recommendations that drive revenue growth and improve overall business performance.

Your Impact

Reporting directly to the Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for:

- Supporting the full lifecycle of the budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring the delivery of accurate and timely analyses.

- Partnering with business stakeholders to identify needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.

- Gathering, documenting, and maintaining data requirements to support both recurring and ad hoc business analyses.

- Developing expertise across multiple data sources and business domains to generate meaningful insights and drive informed decision-making.

- Collaborating with vendors, third-party providers, and cross-functional corporate teams in a dynamic and agile environment.

- Contributing to the continuous enhancement of analytical frameworks, reporting capabilities, and data-driven business processes.

Data Analysis and Insights. Main activities include:

- QA data to ensure accuracy

- Analyze and mine data to find opportunities in time allotted

- Undertake proactive and reactive ad-hoc requests as needed

- Make business recommendations based on the data findings

- Drive more efficient and sophisticated analytical insights

Analysis Distribution. Main activities include:

- Design effective and impactful reports and visualizations for both large and small scale distribution

- Create presentations to highlight recommendations and tell the story

- Ensure partners understand the analysis presented

Analytical Innovation. Main activities include:

- Drive efficiencies to current processes through tools and processes

- Increase the level of sophistication of analyses through statistical, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques

Your Journey so far

- Four plus years of relevant experience in a fast paced, rapidly changing operations environment

- Experience with “big data” environments and tool

- Experience data and analytics

- Experience with budgeting and forecasting processes

- Bachelor’s in mathematics, business administration or IT

Your Essentials

- Fluent English (Knowledge of a second European language is preferred but not essential)

- Excellent analytical skills.

- Previous experience in Revenue Management is essential, possibly in the tourism industry.

- Ability to build business cases from analysis to be sold to senior management, including Chief Revenue Management and Sales, Executive Directors and CEO.

Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità

Il meglio delle vostre avventure è quello che dovete ancora navigare!

Il tuo scopo

Sei appassionato di modellare destinazioni private straordinarie dove il design, la natura e l'ospitalità si uniscono per creare esperienze ospiti indimenticabili?

Porti competenze pratiche nei parchi a tema, nei resort o nelle esperienze dell'isola e nella mentalità analitica per trasformare complesse sfide operative in momenti di vacanza senza soluzione di continuità e ad alto impatto?

Il tuo impatto

MSC Crociere è alla ricerca di un Sr Director of Product Innovation con competenze in ospitalità, F&B e sviluppo resort. In questo ruolo, definirete il futuro delle destinazioni coinvolgenti, fantasiose e fattibili in modo operativo. Potrai combinare intuizioni strategiche, pensiero creativo e competenze operative per ambienti di design che deliziano i nostri ospiti.

Potrai collaborare strettamente con team di marca, sviluppo, progettazione, tecnica e operativa per tradurre requisiti complessi in piani attuabili. Utilizzando intuizioni operative, tendenze del settore e principi di sviluppo sostenibile, formerai concetti che bilanciano la fattibilità, l'innovazione e l'esperienza degli ospiti.

Se si prospera all'incrocio di strategia, analisi e leadership operativa e godere di trasformare concetti visionari in esperienze di vacanza tangibili, memorabili, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Condurre l'ideazione e lo sviluppo concettuale delle destinazioni private, definendo gli obiettivi, la pianificazione master, i parametri operativi e i vincoli tecnici.

- Collabora con team di progettazione, sviluppo, operazioni, F&B, logistica e tecnici per tradurre la visione in piani chiari e attuabili.

- Analizzare le intuizioni operative, le tendenze del settore, le aspettative degli ospiti e le offerte competitive per guidare la raffinatezza dei concetti, il processo decisionale e l'impostazione KPI.

- Coinvolgere e allineare più parti interessate in tutte le regioni, fornendo indicazioni sulle priorità, la fattibilità e gli obiettivi strategici.

- Contribuisci a roadmap a lungo termine per destinazioni private e esperienze resort, garantendo l'allineamento con la visione del marchio e gli obiettivi di esperienza degli ospiti.

- La comprensione dei principi di architettura, progettazione o ingegneria è un plus.

- Pensatore strategico con forti competenze analitiche; in grado di valutare le implicazioni di fattibilità, impatto operativo e esperienza degli ospiti.

- Agile, adattabile e confortevole lavorando in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.

- Passione per la realizzazione operativa di innovazioni orientate agli ospiti.

• Capacità di viaggiare 20-30% del tempo.

Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

Are you passionate about shaping extraordinary private destinations where design, nature, and hospitality come together to create unforgettable guest experiences?

Do you bring hands-on expertise in theme parks, resorts, or island experiences and the analytical mindset to transform complex operational challenges into seamless, high-impact holiday moments?

Your Impact

MSC Cruises is seeking a Sr Director of Product Innovation with expertise in hospitality, F&B and resort development. In this role, you will define the future of engaging, imaginative, and operationally feasible destinations. You will combine strategic insight, creative thinking, and operational expertise to design environments that delight our guests.

You’ll partner closely with brand, development, design, technical, and operational teams to translate complex requirements into actionable plans. Using operational insights, industry trends, and sustainable development principles, you will shape concepts that balance feasibility, innovation, and guest experience.

If you thrive at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and operational leadership and enjoy turning visionary concepts into tangible, memorable holiday experiences, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Journey so far

- Lead the ideation and conceptual development of private destinations, defining objectives, master planning, operational parameters, and technical constraints.

- Collaborate with design, development, operations, F&B, logistics, and technical teams to translate vision into clear, actionable plans.

- Analyse operational insights, industry trends, guest expectations, and competitive offerings to guide concept refinement, decision-making, and KPI setting.

- Engage and align multiple stakeholders across regions, providing guidance on priorities, feasibility, and strategic objectives.

- Contribute to long-term roadmaps for private destinations and resort experiences, ensuring alignment with brand vision and guest experience goals.

- Prepare compelling presentations and documentation to communicate rationale, operational requirements, and recommendations to senior leadership.

- Ensure all proposed concepts adhere to health, safety, environmental, and regulatory standards.

Your Essentials

- 10-15 years of experience in experiential design, destination/resort management with port/cruise operations management a plus.

- Strong operational knowledge of cruise industry logistics, hotel development, port operations, and technical requirements.

- Ability to translate complex operational and technical requirements into clear, actionable concepts.

- Understanding of architectural, design, or engineering principles is a plus.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate and align cross-functional and multicultural teams.

- Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills; able to assess feasibility, operational impact, and guest experience implications.

- Strong communication and presentation skills, able to convey complex ideas to senior and executive leadership.

- Agile, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

- Passion for delivering operationally feasible, guest-focused innovations.

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

-
• Ability to travel 20–30% of the time.

-

-

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Das Beste deiner Abenteuer ist das, das du noch nicht gesegelt hast!

Dein Zweck

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, außergewöhnliche private Ziele zu gestalten, in denen Design, Natur und Gastfreundschaft zusammenkommen, um unvergessliche Gästeerlebnisse zu schaffen?

Bringen Sie praktisches Fachwissen in Themenparks, Resorts oder Inselerlebnissen und die analytische Denkweise mit, um komplexe operative Herausforderungen in nahtlose, wirkungsvolle Urlaubsmomente zu verwandeln?

Ihre Wirkung

MSC Cruises sucht einen Senior Director of Product Innovation mit Expertise in den Bereichen Hospitality, F&B und Resortentwicklung. In dieser Rolle definieren Sie die Zukunft der ansprechenden, phantasievollen und operativ machbaren Ziele. Sie kombinieren strategische Erkenntnisse, kreatives Denken und operatives Know-how, um Umgebungen zu entwerfen, die unsere Gäste begeistern.

Sie arbeiten eng mit Marken-, Entwicklungs-, Design-, technischen und operativen Teams zusammen, um komplexe Anforderungen in umsetzbare Pläne zu übersetzen. jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Sr. Director of Guest Experience Development & Delivery is responsible for bringing the next generation of guest experiences to life across MSC Cruises' new class of ships.
Working closely with the Product Innovation team, this role transforms approved concepts into fully realized onboard experiences, ensuring they are operationally executable, commercially successful, and aligned with the MSC Cruises brand.
Leading the development and delivery of end-to-end guest journeys, service concepts, and onboard experiences, the Sr. Director ensures every experience is launch-ready from ship design and operational planning to crew delivery and guest activation.
The role also plays a key part in defining how new experiences are presented to guests, partnering with internal teams to shape compelling storytelling, positioning, and go-to-market strategies that maximize guest engagement and commercial impact.
As a trusted partner to senior leadership, the Sr. Director regularly presents progress, recommendations, and delivery strategies to executive stakeholders, including the CEO and Chairman, ensuring alignment from concept approval through successful launch.

Your Impact

Experience Development & Delivery

-
Lead the end-to-end development and delivery of new guest experiences, from approved concept through ship launch.

-
Translate approved concepts into guest journeys, service models, operational requirements, and launch plans.

-
Ensure every experience remains true to the original vision while being operationally feasible, commercially successful, and aligned with MSC Cruises' brand standards.

Guest Experience Excellence

-
Champion guest-centric experiences that combine hospitality, storytelling, service excellence, and commercial performance.

-
Design memorable end-to-end guest journeys that create emotional engagement and enhance guest satisfaction.

-
Apply industry best practices and continuous innovation to elevate onboard experiences across the fleet.

Cross-Functional Leadership

-
Lead collaboration across Newbuild, Operations, Marketing, Revenue Management, architects, designers, and external partners to successfully deliver new guest experiences.

-
Ensure alignment between ship design, construction milestones, operational readiness, and launch activities.

-
Manage stakeholder expectations, priorities, risks, dependencies, and decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

Project & Delivery Management

-
Oversee project plans, budgets, timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.

-
Support the SVP with budget oversight, executive reporting, strategic recommendations, and delivery governance.

-
Ensure projects are properly planned, resourced, and delivered on time, within scope, and in line with business objectives.

Executive Communication

-
Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations and project updates for senior leadership, including the CEO and Chairman.

-
Clearly communicate delivery progress, key decisions, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations.

-
Support executive decision-making with data-driven insights, operational considerations, and guest experience perspectives.

Team Leadership

-
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of guest experience professionals.

-
Build capabilities in guest journey design, hospitality delivery, stakeholder management, project execution, and operational integration.

-
Foster a collaborative, accountable, innovative, and guest-first culture while developing future leadership talent.

Performance & Continuous Improvement

-
Define, monitor, and report KPIs related to launch readiness, guest satisfaction, operational adoption, experience quality, and commercial performance.

-
Lead post-launch evaluations, capture lessons learned, and implement continuous improvements to strengthen future experience delivery.

-
Drive a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across all guest experience development activities.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

- 12+ years of experience in designing and delivering physical, in-space guest experiences within hospitality, cruise ships, resorts, themed entertainment, or similar service-driven environments, with a clear focus on onboard or on-site experiences rather than digital products.

- Proven track record of leading large-scale, guest-facing physical experience projects from concept through implementation in complex operational environments such as ships, hotels, or resorts.

- Strong understanding of physical guest experience design, hospitality operations, service excellence, and in-person customer journey development within built environments.

- Demonstrated ability to translate strategic concepts into operationally executable, tangible experiences and launch plans within physical spaces.

- Experienced leader with a proven ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing, cross-functional teams.

- Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills, with experience presenting to executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

- Strong commercial, financial, and analytical mindset, balancing guest experience, operational feasibility, timelines, and investment.

- Experience collaborating with designers, architects, creative agencies, and operational teams to deliver immersive, physical environments and experiences.

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Teams) and presentation tools to develop compelling concepts and executive communications focused on physical experience delivery.

- Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

- Willingness to travel internationally up to 30%.

Your Essentials

-

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.
